criteria.description: Run portable conformance, adversarial protocol and real public-consumer scenarios with exact started/terminal/passed census and source-bound evidence. Missing prerequisites or required skips cannot yield passing qualification.

criteria.description: Preserve the nineteen inventoried Beads database/backup files and old stashes/branches. Record verified zero current issues without assuming backups are empty. No automatic old-operation rebinding or importer for this empty catalog.
criteria.notes: Final integrated source-bound qualification and independent review remain required.

criteria.description: Enforce Hubnot's 256 KiB encoded request ceiling/native limits before mutation. Child bounds: 8 MiB stdout, 64 KiB stderr, 30 seconds. Logical observation: 64 MiB, 10,000 items, 120 seconds including all calls and at most 2 restarts after the initial attempt. Page sizing respects both child and aggregate bounds; never omit a record or truncate fields to fit. Cancellation stops child work.
criteria.notes: Final integrated source-bound qualification and independent review remain required.

criteria.description: Timed compiled-consumer inventory recovers all 1,000 complete mapped current definitions within 120 seconds on the recorded host; separately measure one known-ref observation and one lost-response recovery. Use detailed bounded pages rather than per-issue full-history scans for mappings. Include real adapter metadata and some graph/discussion state; record field/history counts, page size, build/race mode, host/toolchain, commands and elapsed time. Fixture setup is outside timing.
criteria.notes: Final integrated source-bound qualification and independent review remain required.

criteria.description: Formatting, all-package build/static/module checks and applicable complete make quality pass using installed Go 1.26.7. New adapter/codec/recovery tests pass race detection. Real provider qualification is separate from portable stubs.
criteria.notes: Final integrated source-bound qualification and independent review remain required.

criteria.description: Invalid binding/input, unsupported guarantees, stale/conflicting requests and read-only failures cause zero unexpected provider/control/ref writes. A valid append followed by discovered distributed conflict or response loss is retained and reported as applied or ambiguous, never deleted or called unstarted.

criteria.description: Inert SQLite filename patterns in plain .gitignore pass; hidden executable SQLite use and actual forbidden imports/dependencies still fail. No blanket exemption for ignored files/provider data.
